items.title: Will New HIV and Oncology Approvals Redefine Gilead Sciences' (GILD) Treatment Platform Narrative?
items.summary: Gilead Sciences recently secured U.S. FDA approval for Bixlenvo, a once-daily single tablet regimen for virologically suppressed adults with HIV on complex regimens, and European Commission approval for Trodelvy plus Keytruda as a first-line treatment for certain PD-L1–positive metastatic triple-negative breast cancer patients. These back-to-back approvals broaden Gilead’s reach in HIV and oncology by addressing hard-to-treat, heavily pretreated populations with simplified or first-in-class...

items.title: Gilead Keeps Writing Bigger Checks—But Can the Drugs Keep Paying for Them?
items.summary: Gilead's quarterly dividend keeps growing and its HIV cash machine runs hot, but the whole enterprise depends on a single blockbuster drug with a patent expiration already penciled onto a calendar a decade out. Here is what that risk actually means for income investors counting on the check.
